metadata.source: Cot's Baseball Contracts (Baseball Prospectus), per-team compensation sheets, Cycle 41 mirror cache (~/workspace/github/hardball/data/raw/cots/<TEAM>.csv), parsed in full by src/bml_cycle74.py
metadata.basis: Cot's Labor Relations Payroll (LRP). 2026 column in dollars; 2027 column in $M as printed (x1,000,000). Deferred money at present value; option years at the guaranteed buyout where the sheet prints a figure, or the marker 'opt' where it does not. NOT the Spotrac basis of data/salaries_2026.json; never mix the two in one sum.
metadata.grain: one record per sheet row (a player may appear more than once: retained-salary splits, performance bonuses, buyouts and credits are separate sheet rows, kept separate; row_kind=player rows carry a position, row_kind=charge rows carry their note in the contract field)
metadata.validation: multiset agreement with the independent Cycle 41 parse (cots_parsed.csv) on every numeric field, all 30 teams
metadata.team_code_note: the White Sox sheet is filed as CWS.csv; rows are normalized to the repo code CHW
